none: PAS NLM-69CE52: Roman Coin: Copy Denarius of Septimius Severus
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver. Coin. Copy denarius of Septimius Severus (193-211), possibly copied from issue of 198-200 of Laodicea mint. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: SEV[---]G IMPX[---]III. Reverse description: Moneta seated left with scales and cornucopiae. Reverse inscription: [---]AVG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear volume 2 no. 6316 type. Diameter: 18.1mm,…
